ideas.children_he: אַחֲרֵי שָׁנִים שֶׁל כַּעַס, יַעֲקֹב וְעֵשָׂו נִפְגְּשׁוּ וְהִתְחַבְּקוּ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob saw Esau coming with many fighters. He arranged his whole family so everyone looked after their own. Then he bowed down seven times before meeting Esau. Esau ran, hugged, and cried with Jacob.

ideas.children_he: גַּם אַחֲרֵי מְרִיבָה קָשָׁה, אֲנָשִׁים יְכוֹלִים לְהַכִּיר מֵחָדָשׁ אֶת מִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: Esau asked who Jacob’s wives and kids were. Jacob called them his sons and himself Esau’s servant to keep peace. Then all the wives and kids bowed to Esau.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִצִּיעַ מַתָּנָה כְּדֵי לְהַרְאוֹת שֶׁהוּא רוֹצֶה שָׁלוֹם.
ideas.children_en: Esau asked about all the animals Jacob sent as a gift. Jacob said it was a gift to make peace. Esau said he had enough and didn’t need it, but Jacob wanted Esau to be happy, so Esau took the gift.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב דָּאַג לַיְלָדִים וְלַצֹּאן וּבָחַר לָלֶכֶת לְאַט.
ideas.children_en: Esau said they should go together because they are brothers, but Jacob said his children and animals are slow. He asked Esau to go first. Esau said he would send men to protect Jacob, but Jacob said no. Esau went back with animals and continued his way.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב עָצַר לָנוּחַ וּלְהָכִין מָקוֹם לְבַעֲלֵי הַחַיִּים.
ideas.children_en: Jacob traveled to a place called Succoth. He built a house and made shelters for his animals. It was not a permanent home, and he stayed there until he decided what to do next.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִגִּיעַ לְשְׁכֶם וּמָצָא מָקוֹם לַחֲנוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Jacob arrived safely in the city of Shechem. He camped near the city, not inside, so he could make connections with the people there.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב קָנָה חֶלְקַת אֲדָמָה כְּדֵי לִבְנוֹת מָקוֹם קָבוּעַ לְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob bought the land where he made his tent. He bought it from the city leader in Shechem with money or something valuable. Then he built an altar and called it 'El Elohei Yisrael' to show it was important to him.
